text:
Google's own help page says "there's no way to request or pay for a better local ranking on Google."

So your competitor with the big budget can't buy his spot on the map.

He earns it the same way you do. Right main category. Real hours. A review every week.

Someone asked me for the ultimate SEO checklist.

Here it is. Open your Google Business Profile every Monday and check three things.

Main category is what customers type? Hours are right? A new review this week?

Fix whatever says no. Same check next Monday.

Most owners stop asking for Google reviews once they hit 20. (That's plenty, right?)

Then the reviews go quiet. A newer competitor who asks after every job climbs past them on the map.

Keep asking. One review a week, forever.
